original_record.question:
Fourteen white cubes are put together to form the figure on the right. The complete surface of the figure, including the bottom, is painted red. The figure is then separated into individual cubes. How many of the individual cubes have exactly four red faces?

<image1>
original_record.subject: solid geometry

inventory: Fourteen cubes:4×3perimeter ring of10groundcubes withtwo centralholes; extraone atop eachof4corners; no paintcolor yet, no labels.
explicit_conditions: 14whitecubes; allouter surfaces includingbottom paintedred, then separated.
layout_choices: Native cuboids with exact analytic face clipping; no invisible blocks added beyond stated count and source-supported assembly.

answer_check.reasoning: Exactly4redfaces means2face-neighbors. Sixnoncornercubes onbaseperimeter have2neighbors; fourbasecornershave3, fouruppercornercubes have1. Therefore6cubes.
